sub_tasks.desc: Coder Agent: Create React Native application with React context for authentication state management, implement JWT token storage and refresh logic with 15-minute expiry, set up role-based routing and navigation structure, implement automatic token refresh mechanism before expiry.

Coder Agent: Implement login/logout functionality with email/password and social providers, handle OAuth2 callback processing for Firebase, Google, Facebook, manage JWT tokens with secure storage (AsyncStorage with encryption), implement role extraction from JWT payload for RBAC enforcement.

Tester Agent: Achieve minimum 85% code coverage for authentication service, test JWT token management and refresh logic, verify role-based access control enforcement, test OAuth2 integration scenarios.

Coder Agent: Create mobile navigation component with role-specific menu items, implement System Admin full permissions navigation, implement Center Admin center-specific navigation, implement Manager limited permissions navigation, implement Teacher read-only navigation, implement Student course browsing and card navigation.

Coder Agent: Implement System Admin dashboard with global overview, implement Center Admin dashboard with center-specific metrics, implement Manager dashboard with student management tools, implement Teacher dashboard with course schedule, implement Student dashboard with course enrollment and card status.

Tester Agent: Achieve minimum 85% code coverage for navigation component, test role-based menu item rendering, verify navigation permissions for different user roles, test responsive behavior across device sizes.

Coder Agent: Create mobile course list view with CourseID, Title, StartDate, EndDate, TeacherName columns, implement filtering and sorting capabilities for course browsing, exclude courses where student already has enrollment record, add responsive design for mobile viewing.

Coder Agent: Create mobile enrollment form with course selection and confirmation, handle auto-creation of Student account if missing during registration, implement success/error handling with user feedback, integrate with backend enrollment API endpoint.

Tester Agent: Achieve minimum 85% code coverage for course browsing functionality, test course filtering and exclusion logic for enrolled courses, verify API integration and data display accuracy, test enrollment form validation and submission.

Coder Agent: Create mobile QR scanner component using device camera access via Capacitor, implement base64 payload decoding for studentID and courseID, handle scan confirmation and attendance submission, provide visual feedback for successful/duplicate scans.

Coder Agent: Create mobile digital membership card component with remaining validity days display, show total validity days, days used, and days remaining calculation, implement responsive design for mobile viewing, add card renewal call-to-action interface.

Tester Agent: Achieve minimum 85% code coverage for QR scanning functionality, test base64 payload decoding and validation, verify duplicate scan handling and user feedback, test membership card display and calculations.

Coder Agent: Implement device token registration with Firebase Cloud Messaging and APNs, handle push notification reception and display, implement notification click handling and deep linking, manage notification permissions and user preferences.
